cards.card_text: Then he gives the physicians in his service an order about his father.
cards.verse_text: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel.
cards.snippet: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel.

cards.card_text: What does Joseph direct his physicians to do to his father?
cards.verse_text: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel.
cards.snippet: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel.

cards.verse_text: Yet even in his illness he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.
cards.snippet: …in his illness he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.

cards.card_text: He calls them all worthless physicians, the kind of doctor visit where you pay the bill and STILL feel the same.
cards.verse_text: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
cards.snippet: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.

cards.card_text: Is no physician there?' Gilead is a region east of the Jordan River.
She's been through much agony under many physicians, and she's spent all she had.
cards.verse_text: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail.
cards.snippet: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail.

cards.card_text: After all those physicians and all that money, the woman's condition got better.
cards.verse_text: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail.
cards.snippet: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail.

cards.verse_text: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
cards.snippet: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.

cards.card_text: After all those years of trying, one of the physicians finally heals the woman.
cards.verse_text: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
cards.snippet: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.

cards.card_text: Jesus calls her “Daughter,” and then He tells her, “Go in peace.” Twelve years of physicians and empty pockets, and He sends her off in PEACE.
cards.verse_text: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
cards.snippet: She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.

cards.card_text: Then Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send greetings.
cards.verse_text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.
cards.snippet: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.
